resources.string: Type the wallet and the number, key or alias they should send money to. Your agent will tell customers exactly that.

📲 agento confirms payments by reading your wallet\'s notifications. Install it, with notification access, on the phone those alerts arrive on — if your wallet lives on a different phone than your WhatsApp, install it there too.
Account holder name (as shown in the wallet)
Number, key or alias they pay to
+ Add another way to get paid
Remove this way to get paid
Fill in the wallet and the number on row %1$d.
Done. Your agent now knows where you get paid.
We don\'t see the %1$s app on this phone. If your payments land on another phone, install agento there with notification access; otherwise payments won\'t confirm on their own.
